verdict.rationale: The evidence shows data-retrieval endpoints (get accounts and balances, get transactions) and a consent re-authorisation endpoint. None of it documents an on-demand refresh trigger, nor whether calls return live or cached data. Re-authorising a consent is a related but different control and does not count as triggering a data refresh with documented semantics.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented
